title: Review of Approved Adoptions following News of Indonesian Ring Trafficking Babies to Singapore
what_it_is: Review of Approved Adoptions following News of Indonesian Ring Trafficking Babies to Singapore

sections.label: Indonesian baby trafficking investigations
sections.summary: Indonesian authorities are investigating alleged trafficking of Indonesian babies, and Singapore is working with them to review the allegations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Investigations by the Indonesian authorities into the alleged trafficking of Indonesian babies are underway.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Singapore Government is currently working closely with our Indonesian counterparts to review these allegations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) is unable to comment on the number of cases currently under review at this stage.

sections.label: MSF engaging affected families
sections.summary: MSF is engaging affected families, addressing their concerns, and working with authorities to review cases while safeguarding the children's welfare.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF has been engaging affected families to provide more information on processes and to address their concerns as information becomes available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We are also working closely with the relevant authorities to ensure that cases are reviewed expeditiously, while safeguarding the welfare and best interests of the children involved.

sections.label: Ongoing investigations with Indonesian authorities
sections.summary: Investigations are still underway and Singapore is working closely with Indonesian authorities because the matter involves both countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Investigations are still underway and we are trying our very best to work closely because this involves not just within Singapore, but also with the Indonesian authorities.

sections.label: Adoption and citizenship processes delinked
sections.summary: MSF informs prospective adoptive parents that adoption and citizenship processes are delinked and citizenship is not automatic after an adoption order.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: All prospective adoptive parents are also informed of this process during the social investigation procedure, MSF will inform them of that – that the adoption and the citizenship processes are actually delinked processes and the granting of citizenship is not automatic following the adoption order.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We also inform them that the citizenship process can take up to 12 months.

sections.label: Action against errant agencies
sections.summary: Agencies that knowingly bring in children of unknown and suspicious origin will be taken to task and face necessary actions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: If we do uncover that agencies are aware that the children they are bringing in are of unknown and suspicious origin and despite so, bring them in, they will be taken to task.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We will take the necessary actions against those agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We expect the agencies to do due diligence and to bring in children of correct background and origin, having done all the due checks prior to bringing them in.
